I got a question, as I see many people refer to this AA card, "Silver Shadow" as one of the possible sources of new heroes for the game. I see that many of you refer to a sort of Captain Marvel (with a beard) dress in red and yellow, but I am surprised I can not find any references to the guy that appears below him, this pure energy guy that looks like Silver Surfer. And as far as I know, he is also a new hero. Am I wrong? Do we know if the Prime Wardens are five, or six? (AA, Haka, Fanatic, Tempest, the read-and-yellow Captain Marvel, and/or this Silver Surfer guy?

My guess is that both of them will be future heroes in the cosmic expansion we are seeing coming next year at some point. Thematically makes sense, at least. We will still have to deal with the Thorantian giant, but that is another story.

posts.cooked:
Because, at a future point in time, he's going to have a sword.  Same reason Fanatic has her alternate version in that artwork: it's set at a different point in the timeline than the core set, but sometime before the events of the Freedom Six alternate cards.

Now if you're asking why / how he has a sword, that's a very different question that I'm sure will be answered in a later set.

But until then, the standard practice is for folks to throw out their own thoughts on how that kind of thing might happen, so feel free to start that thread!

(Although, I do like Pydro's answer… )

I am 100% certain that Tempet and that sword are linked to a final showdown with Voss.

It's his backup singer/musician, in my opinion.  A manifestation of his power as the Virtuoso of The Void.  Even the Adept only has one set of pipes, so he needs a little assistance through some kind of musician/singer manifestation he summons up with his powers.  They're the guys that sing the chorus while he goes through the verses.  It's especially cool when you can play more than one in a turn.  It feels like a rock ballad!
